column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/BuildTimeTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 4 automatic, 19 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: merged:BuildTime.test_fat_timestamp_encoding.AMomentEncodesAsFATDateAndTime;note:its 7 checks are the seven hand rows, now TEST_P FatTimestamp (rows ReferenceMoment, OddSecondCountsInTwos, FirstFatDay1980, EarlierMomentHeldTo1980, LeapDay2000, LastFatMoment2107, LaterMomentHeldTo2107) under UTC0, bundled as utils.Row/FatTimestamp; every row runs instead of stopping at the first failure

merged:BuildTime.test_fat_timestamp_follows_the_local_zone.UTCEntriesState092204;note:its 6 checks are the six hand rows, split into the four FatTimestampZone cases (one ctest entry each: they change TZ, and the BST case skips on WIN32); each case computes its own stamps under ScopedTimeZone and every fact runs instead of stopping at the first failure

merged:BuildTime.test_parse_source_date_epoch.ADecimalSOURCEDATEEPOCHReads;note:its 6 checks are the six hand rows, now TEST_P SourceDateEpoch (rows Decimal, Zero, Empty, Negative, TrailingText, LeadingSpace), bundled as utils.Row/SourceDateEpoch; the reading rows ASSERT_OK before comparing the value, the refused rows check has_value only, as before (no error code added)

merged:BuildTime.test_fat_timestamp_follows_the_local_zone.UTCEntriesState092204;note:the UTC+9 stamp is the second EXPECT of FatTimestampZone.EntriesFollowTheLocalZone, beside the UTC one it is compared against
ported;note:the case GTEST_SKIPs on _WIN32 instead of being compiled out by #ifndef _WIN32, so it stays listed there

merged:BuildTime.test_fat_timestamp_follows_the_local_zone.SummerTimeEntriesTakeTheSummerOffset;note:the winter stamp is the second EXPECT of FatTimestampZone.BritishSummerTimeEntriesTakeTheSummerOffsetAndWinterEntriesNone, under the same GMT0BST zone
